name: ai-proposal-writer-anna
tagline: Enterprise Proposal Workspace: ROI Calculator, Outreach Sequences, Multi-Currency FX & E-Signatures.
description:
AI Proposal Writer is a comprehensive, enterprise-grade AI proposal creation, quality assurance, and deal management workspace purpose-built for digital agencies, consultancies, freelance developers, and creative studios.

Transform unstructured client briefs into high-converting, professionally formatted proposals with Anna's native AI sampling, deterministic CPQ pricing, real-time client engagement telemetry, Kanban deal pipeline, reusable content libraries, legal contract risk protection, and financial ROI modeling.

### Enterprise Capabilities & Advanced Lifecycle

1. Interactive Client ROI & Economic Surplus Calculator:
- Real-time quantitative economic modeling calculating net ROI %, payback horizon (break-even months), labor savings, and revenue acceleration.
- 1-click 'Inject ROI Analysis' directly inserts a structured business case comparison table into the proposal.

2. AI Sales Follow-Up Cadence & Outreach Sequences:
- High-converting 5-stage automated sales follow-up email sequence customized with client variables, consultative/executive tones, and mailto triggers.

3. Multi-Currency Live FX Converter & International Billing:
- Instant conversion across 9 global currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, AED, SGD, JPY, INR) with configurable volatility buffers.
- 1-click dual-currency settlement terms note insertion for seamless international contracts.

4. Digital E-Signatures & Audit Trail Certificate:
- Tamper-evident digital signatures with interactive drawing canvas and typed calligraphy styles.
- Generates official cryptographic Certificate ID, timestamp, and client session verification hash stamped in exports.

5. AI Deal Win-Probability & Sales Health Scorecard:
- Predictive sales analytics computing 0-100% win probability, commercial deal score, deal-killer alerts, and AI win actions.

6. AI Contract Red-Flag & Scope-Creep Scanner:
- Automated legal vulnerability scan detecting scope drift, client review stalling, premature IP transfers, and third-party liabilities.
- 1-click 'Inject Protective Clause' directly adds battle-tested governance terms to proposals.

7. Interactive 3-Tier Package Comparison:
- Good-Better-Best dynamic tier selector (Starter MVP, Professional Growth, Enterprise Scale) with instant price and scope recalculation.

8. Fullscreen Client Pitch Presentation Deck:
- Fullscreen slide deck mode for client Zoom/Meet calls with keyboard navigation and presenter notes.

9. Client Feedback & Section Discussion Hub:
- Real-time inline question & answer threads between clients and agency teams.

10. Deal Pipeline CRM & Kanban Board:
- Switch seamlessly between Table View and Visual Kanban Pipeline (Drafting, Internal Review, Sent, Won/Accepted, Declined, Archived).

11. Proposal JSON Portability & Multi-Format Suite:
- 1-click JSON backup export and lossless schema import, PDF with digital signature seals, standalone HTML pitch decks, and Markdown exports.
